description: Citi Bike Locations is a dataset listed in Analyzejerseycity open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Planning. Citi Bike Locations and Areas. Coverage: Jersey City, New Jersey. The portal files it under Housing & Properties. Its keywords are Map, bike, Planning. The portal shows 51 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-jerseycitynj-gov-portal.
